arguments.description: List of receivers to send log entries to.

arguments.description: Whether to forward the original journal entry as JSON.

arguments.name: labels
arguments.description: The labels to apply to every log coming out of the journal.

arguments.description: Journal field matches to filter entries using systemd journal match syntax.

arguments.name: max_age
arguments.description: The oldest relative time from process start that Alloy reads.

arguments.description: Path to a directory to read entries from.

arguments.name: relabel_rules
arguments.description: Relabeling rules to apply on log entries.
